_provenance: SHAPE UNVERIFIED, and it is the most speculative file in this directory. THE STILL MODEL HAS NOT BEEN CHOSEN -- config/models.json lists three candidates, all `verified: false`, and modelEntry refuses to hand any of them out. `{ images: [{ url, width, height, content_type }], seed }` is the fal image convention shared by the candidates as far as their catalogue pages show, and `firstImage` in scripts/providers/fal.mjs also accepts a bare `image: { url }` because that is the other shape seen in the wild. Accepting both is not indecision: it is the difference between a model swap being a config edit and being a code change, on a decision that is Paul's and that nobody should pre-empt by hardcoding one vendor's field name.
_shape: GET <response_url> -- 200, for whichever identity-preserving image model is eventually chosen
